iconicAnchor.label: Toulouse-Lautrec's Paris entertainment posters
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The poster demonstrates bold crop, flat color, performer silhouette, compressed space, and integrated lettering working as a complete street-facing communication.

sources.title: Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec and the spectacle of Paris
supports: Belle Époque print culture connected entertainment, celebrity, modern urban life, and repeatable color lithography.

sources.title: Toulouse-Lautrec poster in the collection
supports: A complete period poster proves the style's large silhouette, shallow spatial layers, flat limited color, hand-shaped type, and asymmetric crop.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches poster scale, belle epoque era, organic, display type, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/belle-epoque-lithograph/generated-lead.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
